en.app.title: NkxToolUI
en.main.title: NkxToolUI
en.main.description: Utility for packing, unpacking, browsing NI archives and converting instruments to Ableton Sampler.
en.pack.title: Pack NKX Archive
en.pack.description: Create an archive from a source folder or from a @filelist.txt input with an optional root path.
en.pack.validation.sourceMissing: Please select an existing source folder.
en.pack.validation.fileListMissing: Please select an existing file list.
en.unpack.title: Unpack NKX Archive
en.unpack.header: Extract one or more NKX archives
en.unpack.description: Add one or several archives, choose the destination folder, then start extraction.
en.unpack.status.failed: One or more archives failed to extract.
en.unpack.validation.archivesMissing: Please add at least one NKX archive.
en.browse.title: Browse NKX Archive
en.browse.description: Open an NKX archive and inspect its internal tree. If no real listing is available yet, a temporary mock structure is shown.
en.browse.validation.archiveMissing: Please select an existing NKX archive.
en.browse.column.name: Name
en.unpack.convertToAbleton: Convert extracted NKI instruments to Ableton Sampler presets (.adv)
en.unpack.convertHint: After extraction, every .nki found is converted. Presets and decoded samples are written to the "Ableton Sampler" folder inside the output folder.
en.unpack.noInstruments: No .nki instruments were found in the extracted files.
en.convert.title: Convert NKI to Ableton Sampler
en.convert.header: Convert Kontakt instruments to Ableton Sampler
en.convert.description: Converts Kontakt .nki instruments into Ableton Live Sampler presets (.adv) with their key/velocity zones, crossfades, loops, tuning, volume envelope, round robin and metadata. NCW samples are decoded to WAV.
en.convert.hint: The output uses the Ableton User Library layout (Presets\Instruments\Sampler and Samples\Imported). Copy both folders into your User Library, or drag a preset onto a MIDI track. Samples that are not next to the instrument are searched in the sample folder.
en.convert.noNkiInFolder: No .nki files were found in this folder.
en.convert.status.failed: Some instruments could not be converted.
en.convert.validation.inputMissing: Please add at least one NKI file.
en.convert.validation.sampleFolderMissing: The sample folder does not exist.
